job.title: [Post] Experience: 4–8 years Mandatory skills: • Strong hands-on React.js + Salesforce Commerce C…

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring, API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, RESTful and OCC APIs, and in integrating PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, performance tuning, and techno-functional analysis bridging business and IT. Certified SAP Commerce Cloud professional with strong stakeholder management and AI-assisted development.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: React.js + Salesforce Commerce Cloud Developer
cover_en.hook: I am excited about your focus on building modern, headless commerce experiences with React and SFCC. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in e-commerce platforms, API design and integration that aligns with your technical vision.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: Delivered robust OCC REST APIs and built PIM-ERP data pipelines, enabling seamless product catalog synchronization across global channels.

bullets.label: Headless Commerce
bullets.text: Implemented headless commerce services for storefronts and third-party consumers, supporting modern UI frameworks and rapid feature delivery.

bullets.label: Performance & Scalability
bullets.text: Optimized SQL queries and FlexibleSearch, reducing latency and improving transaction throughput in high-traffic e-commerce environments.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & CI/CD
bullets.text: Led CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) using Jenkins and Docker, ensuring reliable releases and fast time-to-market.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, with a valid work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site work.

tailoring.why_company: I am impressed by your commitment to delivering cutting-edge, headless commerce solutions using React.js and Salesforce Commerce Cloud. Your emphasis on vendor partnerships to accelerate digital storefronts aligns with my experience building scalable, API-driven e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud. I am eager to apply my integration expertise and agile delivery background to help your team launch robust, future-ready commerce experiences for your clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: Joining your team lets me combine my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise with your React/SFCC initiatives, driving fast, reliable headless commerce solutions for your customers.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of e-commerce integration experience. I’m keen to bring my API and headless commerce expertise to your React/SFCC projects. Could we discuss how I can add value?
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will leverage my experience with OCC REST APIs and PIM-ERP integrations to extend your SFCC storefronts and ensure data consistency. I will also apply proven CI/CD practices to streamline your release pipeline and accelerate time-to-market.
tailoring.insight: I see you are seeking vendor partners skilled in React.js and SFCC to build headless storefronts. My background in headless commerce APIs and large-scale integrations can ready the backend services that power those React front-ends, reducing implementation risk.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for React.js + Salesforce Commerce Cloud Developer
tailoring.email_body: I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am attracted to your focus on React.js and SFCC for modern headless commerce. I can bring proven API integration, performance tuning and CI/CD expertise to accelerate your projects. I also noticed your need for robust vendor partners, which aligns with my experience. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
